data.description: 【洛琪希 · 荒野旅行】狂风肆虐的魔大陆荒野上，洛琪希紧紧握着比自己还要高出一头的魔杖，宽大的魔术师长袍在风沙中猎猎作响。她擦去脸颊上的尘土，目光坚定地望向地平线——「这片土地虽然严酷，但只要手中还有魔杖和对前方的向往，就没有克服不了的迷宫。」
data.promptProse: Roxy Migurdia pauses alone across the wilderness plain with her magic staff planted firmly in the earth, looking toward the horizon in her blue witch hat, white blouse and blue skirt. Wind lifts the skirt's hem around the steady stance. The wide view follows open steppe grass beyond her. Golden sunset illuminates hat and staff edges, casting their long shadows into cooler grass toward the foreground.
data.title: 洛琪希 · 荒野旅行
